description_zh: 批量查询研发阶段执行记录
name: ListAppReleaseStageExecutions

parameters.help_en: The serial number (SN) of the release workflow
parameters.name: release_workflow_sn

parameters.help_en: The serial number (SN) of the release stage
parameters.name: release_stage_sn

parameters.help_en: The pagination mode. Set this to `keyset` to use keyset pagination
parameters.help_zh: 分页模式参数：keyset表示键集分页
parameters.name: pagination

parameters.help_en: The number of items to return per page. The value must be an integer from 1 to 100. Default: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页尺寸参数，决定一页最多返回多少对象，默认20，限制[1,100]
parameters.name: per_page

parameters.help_en: The property to sort the results by. Default: `gmtCreate`
parameters.help_zh: 分页排序属性，决定根据何种属性进行记录排序；默认 gmtCreate
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en: The sort order. Use `asc` for ascending order and `desc` for descending order. Default: `desc`
parameters.help_zh: 分页排序升降序，asc 为升序，desc 为降序；默认 desc
parameters.name: sort

parameters.help_en: The pagination token for keyset pagination. To retrieve the next page of results, pass the `nextToken` value from the previous response. Omit this parameter to retrieve the first page
parameters.help_zh: 键集分页 token，获取第一页数据时无需传入，否则需要传入前一页查询结果中的 nextToken 字段
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The page number to retrieve. This parameter is used for page number-based pagination and is ignored if `pagination` is set to `keyset`
parameters.help_zh: 键集分页模式下不需要传入
parameters.name: page

schema.description_en: A paginated list of release stage executions

current.description_en: The current page number. This parameter is returned only for page number-based pagination
current.description_zh: 页码分页时存在该字段，表示当前页
current.title_en: 页码分页时存在该字段，表示当前页
current.title_zh: 页码分页时存在该字段，表示当前页

data.description_en: An array of objects. Each object represents a release stage execution

endTime.description_en: The time when the pipeline execution ended

startTime.description_en: The time when the pipeline execution started

nextToken.description_en: The pagination token used to retrieve the next page of results. This parameter is returned only for keyset pagination
nextToken.description_zh: 采用键值分页时存在该字段，用于传给分页接口，迭代获取下一页数据
nextToken.title_en: 采用键值分页时存在该字段，用于传给分页接口，迭代获取下一页数据
nextToken.title_zh: 采用键值分页时存在该字段，用于传给分页接口，迭代获取下一页数据

pages.description_en: The total number of pages. This parameter is returned only for page number-based pagination
pages.description_zh: 页码分页时存在该字段，表示总页数
pages.title_en: 页码分页时存在该字段，表示总页数
pages.title_zh: 页码分页时存在该字段，表示总页数

perPage.description_en: The number of entries on the current page. This parameter is returned only for page number-based pagination
perPage.description_zh: 页码分页时存在该字段，表示每页大小
perPage.title_en: 页码分页时存在该字段，表示每页大小
perPage.title_zh: 页码分页时存在该字段，表示每页大小

total.description_en: The total number of entries. This parameter is returned only for page number-based pagination
total.description_zh: 页码分页时存在该字段，表示结果总数
total.title_en: 页码分页时存在该字段，表示结果总数
total.title_zh: 页码分页时存在该字段，表示结果总数
